issues.message: Drawn for the decoration step, not built: minecraft:water, minecraft:lily_pad.
Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: cornflower, allium, cauldron, fern, oxeye_daisy, sweet_berry_bush, clay, brewing_stand, candle, white_wall_banner.
1538 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
12 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.artefacts: Still no readable red cross: the three 'red-cross banners' at (1,3,0),(15,3,0),(8,7,0) are plain white banners. Carlton's red-cross note is not met.
notes.roof: The automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm: the renders show the dark oak eaves overhanging all round. Marked down only for the single-colour ring and the weak cross gable.
notes.levels: L3 adds a back herb strip, a log pile, barrels, two lantern posts and two more white banners; the front view is almost the same as L2. Detail capped at 1.
notes.life: Herb strip, berry bushes, flowers and lanterns.

visual.summary: Adds two more banners, lantern posts at the door, a herb garden strip and log pile at the back, and barrels.
problems: Healing sign does not read: white_wall_banner at (1,3,0),(15,3,0),(8,7,0) all show plain white. Build the red cross in blocks on the upper storey over the door (as the infirmary v4 does with red_wool on white_wool), since banner patterns can't be stored and the banner shows plain white: e.g. red_wool at (8,5,1),(8,6,1),(8,7,1),(7,6,1),(9,6,1) with white_wool at (7,5,1),(9,5,1),(7,7,1),(9,7,1), replacing the posts at x7/x9 y5..7 and the pane at (8,6,1); keep it on every level, and move the banner at (8,7,0) so it doesn't cover the cross. The corner banners can stay as extra decoration once the block cross is there.
Dirt-cube planters from L2 remain at (3,0,0),(6,0,0),(10,0,0),(13,0,0): give them a box rim.
L3 needs a clearly visible new feature (e.g. a fenced herb garden with a gate at the front or side, or a covered ambulance/stretcher porch), not more props.
Reach: 310 of 566 reached; unreached are roof, eaves, canopy top, log-pile tops and a brewing stand top: fine.
